general_skills.title: Build Lean Search Query
general_skills.principle: Combine product type with 1–2 essential functional attributes and any hard‑constraint keywords (size, color, price) or niche descriptors. Omit decorative or secondary terms.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When crafting an initial or refined search query, especially for attributes not filterable by site controls.

general_skills.title: Refine Search Iteratively
general_skills.principle: If results are off‑target, tweak keywords (synonyms, remove over‑constraining terms) or apply site filters. Do not repeat identical queries.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After a search results page shows mostly irrelevant items.

general_skills.title: Preview Results Before Clicking
general_skills.principle: Scan titles, thumbnails, and listed prices in the results list. Only open items that plausibly meet all hard constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: On any search results page before clicking a product link.

general_skills.title: Hard-Constraint First Pass
general_skills.principle: Immediately on the product page, check product type, category, and every hard constraint (budget, size, color). If any fails, leave the page at once. Secondary attributes are only considered after hard constraints pass.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Within the first observation of every product detail page.

general_skills.title: Set Variants and Verify
general_skills.principle: Select all mandatory variant options; then confirm the exact post‑selection price is within budget. If after two‑three different variant choices no combination meets all constraints, abandon this product and go back to search.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After confirming product type matches, and when price is shown as a range or varies with options.

general_skills.title: Inspect Hidden Specifications
general_skills.principle: Open the Description/Features section to check attributes not visible in the summary (material, care instructions, etc.). Skip the item if a required spec remains unconfirmed.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When a constraint is not evident from the title, images, or variant list.

general_skills.title: Navigate Result Pages
general_skills.principle: If the first page lacks suitable candidates, proceed to later pages or adjust sorting/filters before declaring the product unavailable.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When initial results are insufficient and pagination is indicated.

general_skills.title: Do Not Revisit Rejects
general_skills.principle: Once a product has been deemed unsuitable, do not click into it again unless new information indicates it may now match.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Whenever you consider re‑opening a previously rejected item.

general_skills.title: Buy Without Hesitation
general_skills.principle: As soon as all constraints are validated on the selected variant and price is acceptable, execute the purchase action immediately; no extra navigation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After full validation of the current product variant.

general_skills.title: Exit Gracefully
general_skills.principle: If after varied searches and refinements no product satisfies all hard constraints, report failure. When a product meets all hard constraints but misses some soft ones, and the step budget is nearly exhausted, pick the best available match and note the unmet soft attributes.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the search is exhaustive or the step limit is close.

apparel.title: Strip Query to Core
apparel.principle: Build search query from only product type and mandatory attributes (gender, garment category, material, sleeve/fit, max price). Drop subjective or decorative words (e.g., 'stylish', 'cool') and redundant synonyms to avoid overly narrow results.
apparel.when_to_apply: Before every new or refined search.

apparel.title: Immediate Core Match Check
apparel.principle: As soon as a product page loads, compare its title and breadcrumb category to the required garment type and primary attributes. If any mismatch is detected, go back to the search results immediately without further reading.
apparel.when_to_apply: Right after opening any product detail page.

apparel.title: Variant Selection First
apparel.principle: Before checking price or considering purchase, select the exact size and color (or other required options) from the page controls. Never evaluate a product without first setting the correct variant.
apparel.when_to_apply: On a relevant product page that offers size, color, or style options.

apparel.title: Variant Price Verification
apparel.principle: After selecting the correct variants, check the displayed price for that specific combination. If the variant price exceeds the budget, abandon the product and return to results; do not try another variant.
apparel.when_to_apply: Immediately after variant selection and before proceeding to purchase.

apparel.title: Hidden Specifications Check
apparel.principle: Scroll to the item description, bullet points, or specifications section to verify any required attributes not visible in the title (e.g., exact fabric composition, care instructions, fit details). If the information is missing or contradicts requirements, reject the product.
apparel.when_to_apply: Before finalizing purchase on a candidate product, when critical attributes are not stated in the title.

apparel.title: Adaptive Search Strategy
apparel.principle: If initial search results contain no suitable items, broaden the query by removing the rarest constraint (e.g., a specific pattern or secondary attribute) and search again. If needed, scan multiple pages of results instead of repeating the same query or revisiting previously discarded products.
apparel.when_to_apply: After a search returns exclusively irrelevant or out-of-stock products.

footwear.title: Load Search Constraints
footwear.principle: Always enter every hard requirement (type, function, color, size, max price) into the initial search query. Do not start with a broad search and then filter manually.
footwear.when_to_apply: Before the first search and whenever restarting a search cycle.

footwear.title: Verify Key Features
footwear.principle: Open the product description/specs and confirm that all required functional attributes (e.g., slip-resistant, rubber sole) are explicitly present. If any required feature is missing, discard the product immediately.
footwear.when_to_apply: As soon as you open a product page, before selecting variants or buying.

footwear.title: Select Variants First
footwear.principle: Before clicking any purchase button, choose the exact color and size options on the product page. If the requested variant is out of stock or unavailable, abandon this product right away.
footwear.when_to_apply: Once you have opened a candidate product and verified its key features.

footwear.title: Check Variant Price
footwear.principle: After selecting the variant, check its displayed price and ensure it is strictly below the user’s maximum budget. If the price exceeds the cap, exit the product; do not proceed to checkout.
footwear.when_to_apply: Immediately after selecting color/size and just before clicking 'Buy Now' or similar.

footwear.title: Exit Non-Matches Fast
footwear.principle: At any point during browsing, if the product or search result page clearly violates a hard constraint (wrong category, out-of-stock, over budget, missing color/size, no required feature), stop and move to the next candidate. Do not waste steps toggling options or adjusting filters.
footwear.when_to_apply: Anytime you notice a definitive mismatch.

home_decor.title: Construct Query with All Constraints
home_decor.principle: Combine every user-specified constraint—product type, color, size, shape, features, and maximum price—into the initial search query. Never omit any known attribute.
home_decor.when_to_apply: At the start of a search or when current results fail to meet all constraints.

home_decor.title: Match Exact Product Category
home_decor.principle: Check that the product's displayed category matches the exact product type the user requested (e.g., 'pillow', 'rug', 'wall art'). If it does not match, close the page and continue searching.
home_decor.when_to_apply: Immediately after opening a product page from search results.

home_decor.title: Select Each Required Variant
home_decor.principle: For every configurable attribute (color, size, shape, etc.), choose the exact option the user specified. After each selection, verify that the product's displayed attributes and price still align with user constraints.
home_decor.when_to_apply: After landing on a product page that offers variant selectors.

home_decor.title: Check Hidden Specifications
home_decor.principle: If any user requirement (material, washability, printing method, etc.) is not visible on the main page, expand the Description, Features, and Specs tabs to locate that information.
home_decor.when_to_apply: When a user-specified characteristic is missing from the product title, thumbnail, or main listing.

home_decor.title: Skip Non-Qualifying Products
home_decor.principle: If a product fails any user constraint after full inspection, return to the search results or refine the search query. Do not reopen or interact with that product again during this task.
home_decor.when_to_apply: After confirming a product does not meet all requirements.

home_decor.title: Verify All Before Purchase
home_decor.principle: Only click 'Buy Now' after double-checking that the product type, selected variants, and final price exactly match every user constraint. If any mismatch remains, keep searching.
home_decor.when_to_apply: Right before clicking the purchase button on a configured product page.

electronics.title: Constraint-Rich Search
electronics.principle: Include the product type and every mandatory attribute (features, color, size, max price) in the initial search query. This yields results that match the entire specification from the start.
electronics.when_to_apply: When beginning a new product hunt or when current results are too broad or irrelevant.

electronics.title: Configure In-Page Variants
electronics.principle: Once you open a candidate product, immediately set color, size, model, and any other variant selectors. Check if the displayed title and description update to match all requested specs.
electronics.when_to_apply: Right after clicking a search result to open a product page.

electronics.title: Hard-Gate Price & Specs
electronics.principle: Before clicking “Buy Now,” cross-check the on‑screen price and specs. Abandon the item if cost exceeds budget or any required feature, color, or size is missing or mismatched.
electronics.when_to_apply: After configuring all variants, immediately before initiating purchase.

electronics.title: Bail on Mismatch Fast
electronics.principle: If selecting variant options does not update the product details to the required spec, or if the page remains incompatible, use “Back to results” and choose a different item. Do not retry the same product.
electronics.when_to_apply: When repeated variant selections leave the displayed title or specs unchanged or still wrong.

electronics.title: Prioritize High-Match Results
electronics.principle: Quickly scan search result titles for those that contain the most mandatory keywords (e.g., all required features, color, size). Open the best match first rather than automatically selecting the first result.
electronics.when_to_apply: On any search results page with multiple potential electronics products.

electronics.title: Avoid Click Loops
electronics.principle: Mentally track visited products and executed searches. If progress stalls and you revisit the same page or identical query without new insight, refine the search terms or switch to a different candidate immediately.
electronics.when_to_apply: When you detect you are about to repeat an action that already failed.

accessories.title: Constraint-Packed Search Query
accessories.principle: Before the first search, build a single query that combines the accessory type (e.g., 'backpack') with every specific constraint the user gave (color, size, budget, material, washability). Use the user's exact words, separated by spaces, to get the most relevant results.
accessories.when_to_apply: Before the first search when the user provides multiple specific requirements.

accessories.title: Explicit Variant Click
accessories.principle: On a product page with options (color, size, pattern, etc.), find the exact option the user requested and click it. Visually confirm the selection is highlighted. Never trust the default selection, even if it seems to match.
accessories.when_to_apply: Immediately after opening a product that offers multiple variant options.

accessories.title: Function Fit Verification
accessories.principle: Read the product's title and full description to check that its intended use matches exactly what the user wants (e.g., 'eyeshadow case' vs. 'makeup bag'). If the fit is ambiguous or clearly wrong, reject the product and move to the next search result.
accessories.when_to_apply: Right after landing on a product page that seems category-relevant but may have a different intended use.

accessories.title: Post-Variant Price Check
accessories.principle: After selecting all required variants, check the final displayed price. If it exceeds the user's budget, do not proceed; instead, go back to the search results and try the next candidate.
accessories.when_to_apply: Just before adding to cart or starting checkout.

accessories.title: Fallback on Unavailable Variant or Failed Constraint
accessories.principle: If the required color/size/pattern is not available or any user constraint (budget, material, etc.) fails after inspection, close the product immediately. Then open the next search result. Never force a match with a product that does not fully meet the user's needs.
accessories.when_to_apply: When the product lacks the needed option or violates any key constraint after inspection.

beauty_health.title: Combined Constraint Search
beauty_health.principle: Form a search query that includes the product type AND every user-specified filter (price, color, size, material, feature keywords) in a single query.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: The user provides multiple explicit requirements (e.g., price range plus a feature).

beauty_health.title: Exact Feature Match Click
beauty_health.principle: Click the first search result whose title contains the exact feature phrase the user mentioned (e.g., "long handle", "dry hair").
beauty_health.when_to_apply: After search results appear and at least one result title includes that exact feature phrase.

beauty_health.title: Variant Selection
beauty_health.principle: On the product page, select the variant (color, size, pack, etc.) that matches each user-specified attribute before proceeding.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: The product page has selectable options and the user gave such attributes.

beauty_health.title: Price Ceiling Check
beauty_health.principle: Check the displayed price (including variant) against the user's maximum budget. If over budget, abandon the product and return to search results immediately.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: Right after variant selection and before clicking 'Buy Now'.

beauty_health.title: Direct Purchase
beauty_health.principle: Proceed straight to 'Buy Now' without browsing other products once the current item meets all user requirements.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: All constraints (type, attributes, price) are confirmed satisfied on the current product page.

other.title: Construct Precise Search Query
other.principle: Build the search query by combining the exact product name with all required attributes (color, size, material, max price). Activate the price filter if available.
other.when_to_apply: Right before issuing any product search.

other.title: Validate Category Match
other.principle: Open a result only when its title explicitly matches the requested product type. If the page reveals a different product category, close it immediately and try the next result.
other.when_to_apply: Immediately upon landing on a product detail page.

other.title: Verify Variant Selection
other.principle: After selecting a variant (color, size, pack), wait for the page to update. Confirm the title or price reflects the chosen variant. If not, reselect or try another listing.
other.when_to_apply: Whenever you interact with dropdowns or swatches on a product page.

other.title: Check Fixed Specifications
other.principle: Scan the product description and feature list. Confirm that all mandatory non-selectable requirements (material, functions, care instructions) are explicitly met.
other.when_to_apply: After selecting all configurable options and just before clicking 'Buy Now'.

other.title: Refine Search When Unsuccessful
other.principle: If the first results page has no adequate match, modify the query: remove the least critical keyword, use synonyms, or adjust the price slider. Do not re-click unsuitable items.
other.when_to_apply: After reviewing an entire results page with no satisfying match.

other.title: Adhere to Task Sequence
other.principle: Follow this strict order: search, open a candidate, apply variants, verify all specs and price, then click Buy Now. Skip unnecessary back-and-forth.
other.when_to_apply: Throughout every shopping task from start to checkout.

common_mistakes.description: Submitting a search query that omits key constraints (e.g., size or price cap), leading to an overwhelming or irrelevant result set.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent focuses on main keywords (product + attributes) and forgets secondary filters like price, size, or color.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Always assemble the full requirement list first, then build the query so every mandatory constraint (category, attributes, price) is explicitly included.

common_mistakes.description: Using overly specific or uncommon color/variant names in the initial search, returning zero or few results.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Agents translate the user-given color directly into the query without considering site vocabulary or synonyms.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Start with broader color families (e.g., "red" instead of "dusty blush") and narrow down with on-page filters once results appear.

common_mistakes.description: Selecting a visually similar but wrong product category (e.g., picking dress pants instead of dress shirts).
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Thumbnail images can be misleading and the agent may rely solely on visual similarity without verifying category metadata.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Cross-check product titles and breadcrumb/category labels against the requested category before clicking or purchasing.

common_mistakes.description: Failing to notice that the displayed price changes after selecting the required size or color, causing budget overruns.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Agents often check price only on the default variant and assume it persists across all options.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: After every option change (size, color, etc.) re-read the price element and abort if it exceeds the budget.

common_mistakes.description: Adding an item to cart without first setting mandatory variant options, triggering errors or adding an unintended default variant.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent clicks “Buy Now” immediately because the button is visible and enabled, overlooking required selections.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Before purchasing, validate that every required dropdown/radio option (size, color, length, pack count) has been explicitly selected.

common_mistakes.description: Assuming all desired attributes (e.g., material, wash type) are present without reading the product description.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Agents may treat search filters as guarantees and skip verifying details on the product page.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Parse the bullet list or specifications section to confirm every non-variant attribute (material, care, outsole type) is actually listed.

common_mistakes.description: Ignoring shipping costs or add-on pricing that push the total above the user’s budget.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent monitors only the item price field and forgets additional fees displayed later in checkout.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Include a price-check step after adding to cart or at checkout that sums item cost, shipping, and taxes, then compare with budget.

common_mistakes.description: Misinterpreting size labels (e.g., confusing '5X' with '5X-Large Tall' or regional shoe size systems).
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Websites present multiple size systems, and agents may pick the first matching number/string without context.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Match the full size token (including modifiers like 'Tall', 'Wide', or units) and prefer exact string matches over partial matches.

common_mistakes.description: Skipping availability checks and attempting to purchase out-of-stock variants, leading to failure screens.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Agents often assume a listed option is purchasable without reading stock indicators or disabled buttons.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: After selecting each variant, verify that the 'Add to Cart/Buy Now' button remains enabled and that no 'Out of Stock' message appears.

common_mistakes.description: Navigating back to the results page after configuring a product, causing loss of selected options and wasted steps.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent re-evaluates alternatives but forgets that UI state resets on navigation.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Cache the current page state or finish purchase before leaving; if further comparison is needed, open new tabs/windows instead of back navigation.

common_mistakes.description: Clicking sponsored or irrelevant ads that match keywords loosely, diverting the workflow away from suitable products.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Some search result layouts give ads prominence, and agents may not distinguish them from organic results.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Detect ad/disclaimer labels (e.g., 'Sponsored') and prioritize organic listings that more reliably satisfy user constraints.

common_mistakes.description: Applying mutually exclusive or contradictory filters (e.g., selecting both a specific size and a 'one-size' filter), yielding empty results.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent applies every stated constraint mechanically without understanding that some filters override or negate others.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Reason about filter compatibility: if a required variant is chosen on the product page, avoid redundant or conflicting global filters.
